subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Number 4: numeral and number word 'four'; things that come in fours

show.line: This is four. Four toothbrushes for a family of four. Four!

rounds.prompt: Some things come in fours. Which one has four wheels?
rounds.praise: Yes! A taxi has four wheels.

rounds.prompt: Jump and count with me. One, two, three. What comes next?
Draw four with your finger. Go down, go across, then one long line down.

hints: Four comes after three. One, two, three, four.
Touch each one as you count. Stop at the last one.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will count the toothbrushes.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! I missed one. There are four toothbrushes.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count together. One, two, three, four!

parent_line: Can recognise, count and trace the number 4.
